description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md and conventions/tools.md to understand profiles (coding, messaging, minimal), group shorthands (group:ui, group:runtime), alsoAllow semantics, and exec security options. (2) Update ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json with: global tools.alsoAllow containing both 'lobster' and 'llm-task' (NOT tools.allow, which would replace the list); global tools.exec with host='gateway', security='allowlist', ask='on-miss'; global tools.byProvider['google/gemini-2.5-flash'] = {profile: 'coding'}. (3) For orchestrator-001: set tools.profile='coding' and tools.deny=['group:ui']. (4) For notifier-003: set tools.profile='messaging' and tools.deny=['group:runtime']. (5) For summarizer-002: set tools.profile='minimal' (or equivalent least-privilege). Key traps: using 'allow' instead of 'alsoAllow' for plugins (destructive), wrong exec security values, wrong byProvider key format, missing group: prefix in deny lists, using 'full' instead of 'allowlist' for exec security.
